method: Windows of 1 km (25x25 px of 40 m). Earth: DEM read +-800 m around the site and resampled (average) to a local azimuthal-equidistant 40 m grid. Slope by central differences, two fields from the same gradients: slope_shape (heights relative to the best-fit plane of each window, i.e. without regional tilt) and slope_raw (physical slope, no plane removal). Slope histograms: 18 bins of 2.5 deg from 0 to 45 deg, slopes >= 45 deg in the last bin, normalized to 1 (hist_shape from slope_shape, hist_raw from slope_raw). slope_frac_above: exact fraction of the window pixels with slope_raw >= 15, 20 and 25 deg. Roughness: mean std of elevation after removing a best-fit plane in non-overlapping sub-blocks of 120, 360 and 1000 m. Slope distance: Wasserstein-1 between hist_shape histograms, divided by 42.5 deg (max). Roughness distance: each scale is converted to its mid-rank percentile (0-100) within the lunar windows of the same scale, then ||p1 - p2|| / (100 * sqrt(3)) (in [0, 1]; no saturation for very flat Earth sites). Weights 0.5 / 0.5 (a choice). Similarity (%) = 100 * (1 - (w_slope * W1_norm + w_rough * d_rough)). Lunar windows: non-overlapping, fully south of 85 deg S. Differences block per site: for each slope threshold the fraction of the window above it, and for each roughness scale the value, each with the lunar p25 / p50 / p75, the lunar percentile of the site and a direction: value > lunar p75 -> higher, < lunar p25 -> lower, else similar. Top-level not_covered lists what a 40 m terrain comparison cannot say.

sources.earth: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (COG on AWS), 30 m, averaged onto a local 40 m grid
sources.moon: LRO LOLA LDEM_85S_40M (NASA PDS Geosciences Node, lro-l-lola-3-rdr-v1), 40 m/pixel, 85S-90S

slope_thresholds.15: taken from the VIPER nominal slope limit
slope_thresholds.20: taken from the NASA LTV slope requirement
slope_thresholds.25: taken from the Apollo LRV slope limit

slope_thresholds_source: docs/scenarios.md (NASA NTRS 20240013903 and 20250004148 for VIPER; NASA SP-4214 ch. 13 for the Apollo LRV; LTV figure from a secondary summary of the NASA solicitation)
not_covered: Features smaller than about 40 m (rocks, boulders, small craters) are invisible in a 40 m DEM.
Surface material (regolith versus Earth soils and rock: strength, grain size, cohesion) is not compared.
Lunar gravity (1/6 g) is not modelled.
Illumination, shadows and temperature are not part of this terrain comparison.
The 15 / 20 / 25 deg thresholds come from vehicle specifications; they are reference values, not measurements.
